name: sheet-drawer
title: Sheet Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom over a dimmed page, with focus trap and Escape. The bottom sheet drags down to dismiss; no slide under reduced motion.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer asks to open or close.

props.name: footer
props.description: Buttons row pinned to the bottom.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the drawer slides in from. The bottom drawer drags down to dismiss.
